'''Animated iron armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use an [[iron platebody]], [[iron platelegs]], and an [[iron full helm]] on the [[magical animator]]. Like the [[Animated Steel Armour|steel]] and [[Animated Bronze Armour|bronze]] animated armour, iron isn't commonly used for two main reasons: platelegs will occasionally be lost, and higher variants yield better [[Warrior guild token|tokens]] per hour.

If players do decide to fight the iron armour, it is suggested to carry a few extra [[iron platelegs]] to replace the ones that get destroyed. If possible, players should fight animated armour made of [[Animated Black Armour|black]] or higher instead, due to the fact that they will not lose any parts.

Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]].
